help.intro: The Data Exchange Center lets you download blank or example-filled templates, fill them in Excel or a spreadsheet tool, and safely bring the data back into FormuLab. Nothing is written until you have previewed the file and explicitly confirmed the import.
help.rowStates: Each row is classified before anything is written: a new record, an update to an existing one, unchanged, a duplicate within the file, a warning, an invalid row, or a missing reference. Only valid rows are imported by default — importing rows with issues requires explicitly choosing a partial import.
help.security: Every export neutralizes spreadsheet formulas so a file can never run code when opened in Excel; every import strips the same triggers back out. Files are checked for size and row-count limits before parsing.
help.authorization: Each template only accepts imports from specific roles, and some fields — verification status, approvals, reviewer sign-off — can never be set by an import, however the file is filled in. Those always require the normal, authorized workflow inside FormuLab.
